item.title: Parsing out clear signals from noise with Dimensions data
item.dc:creator: Misha Kidambi
item.description: Universities face growing pressure to identify emerging areas of research within an increasingly complex and interdisciplinary scholarly landscape. This article explores a methodological approach to separating meaningful signals from noise in large-scale publication data, and how Dimensions can support evidence-informed academic strategy.
